plugin.name: fireflies
plugin._long: Glowing fireflies wandering and blinking over the whole screen until toggled off. The desktop stays usable.

option.name: toggle
option._long: Starts the fireflies; they keep flying until the binding is used again. Also available as the IPC method fireflies/toggle.

option.name: size
option._long: Radius of the glow around each firefly in pixels.

option.name: speed
option._long: Flying and blinking speed in percent (100 = normal).
